What’s Streaming on HBO Max?

HBO Max has a wide selection of original TV series, including House of the Dragon , The Last of Us , Succession , Game of Thrones , Hacks , Rooster , Dune: Prophecy , The Pitt , The Sex Lives of College Girls and others. It has hit movies, such as Dune and Dune: Part Two , How to Make a Killing , Sinners , Weapons , A Minecraft Movie , The Batman , Barbie and more.

In addition, the streaming service has all sorts of music programming, like Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That’s the Weight of the World) , Yacht Rock: A DOCKumentary , Juice WRLD: Into the Abyss , Woodstock 99: Peace, Love, and Rage , Jason Isbell: Running With Our Eyes Closed , Little Richard: I Am Everything , Love To Love You, Donna Summer and many others.

It has live sports too, with streaming access to games and events from NHL, NCAA Men’s March Madness, NASCAR, MLB and other leagues.

For Black Friday weekend, you can get HBO Max is on sale for $5.49 per month (was $10.99 per year) for your first 12 months of service, a 50% savings.
